mindmap.comment: Read the mindmap header and its body. Follows mindmap.md#detection.

patterns.comment: A diagram comment starts at %% where a unit starts in the statement context and runs to the end of its line segment; LF, U+2028, or U+2029 ends it. Node text, shape text, and class text own percent pairs inside them. Padding stops before separator-led common comments, which own their following directive-looking text. Neither percent sign of the mark belongs to a directive. Follows mindmap.md#comments, common.md#comment-lines, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Read the class marker and the following class name. Follows mindmap.md#the-statement-context and mindmap.md#the-icon-and-class-contexts.
Read the icon opener as one keyword and its retained name as text, ending at the icon bracket. Follows mindmap.md#the-icon-and-class-contexts.
Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows mindmap.md#the-icon-and-class-contexts and common.md#comment-lines.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

patterns.comment: The openers are -), (-, )), ), ((, {{, (, and [, in that order. rule 3: The closers are )), ), ], }}, (-, -), ((, and (, in that order. The closer need not match the opener. Strings start only at a unit start, right after the opener; shape text keeps quotes after its first character and has no HTML rule. Follows mindmap.md#the-statement-context and mindmap.md#the-shape-context.
A quote and backtick start a markdown string, closed by backtick and quote. Follows mindmap.md#the-shape-context.
A double quote starts a string ending at the next double quote, without escapes. Follows mindmap.md#the-shape-context.
Shape text takes as many characters other than ), ], (, and } as possible; quotes, percent pairs, {, and [ after its first character are text. Follows mindmap.md#the-shape-context.
Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows mindmap.md#the-shape-context and common.md#comment-lines.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read node text before its shape at a statement start, including after a directive. Follows mindmap.md#the-statement-context and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Read a bare node label after indentation or a directive, requiring text outside directives and whitespace. Follows mindmap.md#directives-inside-units and mindmap.md#the-statement-context.
